title: Watch: Jantar Mantar CJP Celebrates Dharmendra Pradhan’s Resignation
content:
Dharmendra Pradhan, in a post on X on Saturday (July 25, 2026), announced that he has tendered his resignation from the post of Union Education Minister.

Protestors gathered in Jantar Mantar celebrate with the Chak De India song. Crowd continues to swell in Jantar Mantar even after Dharmendra Pradhan stepped down as Union Education Minister.

title: Quashing of FIRs, compensation & 5-point Charter: What Centre, CJP said in joint press meet
content: The Cockroach Janta Party ended its 36-day protest at Jantar Mantar. This decision followed three rounds of talks with the central government delegation. The government accepted two key demands, including the minister's resignation. All legal cases filed against protesters and organizers will now be withdrawn. The party continues to pursue compensation for families affected by the NEET paper leak.

title: Energy security: What India’s crude, LPG & LNG strategic reserves strategy should look like
content: Once completed, the total strategic petroleum reserves capacity will increase to 11.88 MMT, enabling India to move significantly closer to the 90-day reserve target. India is working with the UAE for 30 million barrels of crude of storage capacity.

title: ‘It's all about the attitude’: Shreyas hails young India after first series win as captain
content: India secured a dominant series victory against Zimbabwe under Shreyas Iyer's leadership.  Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma's aggressive batting propelled India to a substantial total.  The bowlers then effectively restricted Zimbabwe to a manageable score in the second match.  This series win highlighted the young team's positive and attacking approach to the game.

title: Jeff Bezos ex-wife MacKenzie Scott helped write a 'donation playbook' for Snap founder
content: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: NY mayor hires Lina Khan who went after Amazon, Meta and Google in her days as FTC head
content: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has roped in Lina Khan to lead the board of directors for the New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The former chair of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) known for her aggressive antitrust lawsuits against Big Tech. According to Business Insider, Mamdani called the duo a “dream team” and framed the appointments as a strategic effort to pair urban business growth with his progressive affordability agenda.

title: Zebra mussels spread across all Great Lakes within a decade of arriving in 1988
content: Zebra mussels, an aquatic invader from Eurasia, continue their continental spread after arriving in North America.  These tiny shellfish are now infesting Lake Meredith in Texas, raising new concerns.  Officials confirmed a reproducing population, marking the lake as a potential stepping stone.  The mussels damage ecosystems and infrastructure by clinging to hard surfaces and multiplying rapidly.  Preventative measures like cleaning boats remain crucial to slowing their ongoing invasion.

title: Scientists thought insects could not survive deep water, these larvae can
content: Lake fly larvae in Lake Malawi exhibit a remarkable daily vertical migration. These Chaoborus edulis larvae possess specialized air sacs for buoyancy control.  A unique pH-powered mechanism allows them to precisely manage their depth.  These larvae can withstand extreme pressures, challenging previous scientific assumptions.  This discovery offers insights into insect evolution and potential material science applications.

title: Zandi says tariffs fueling US price surge; claims policy shift could quickly cool inflation
content: Economist Mark Zandi states inflation stems from deliberate policy choices. Tariffs and restrictive immigration laws are identified as key contributors to price pressures. These policies diminish the workforce, intensifying labor shortages and raising costs. Underlying economic forces are pushing inflation down, but policy hurdles overpower them. Zandi concludes that ending these policies will allow inflation to recede.

title: India crush Zimbabwe by 90 runs as Shreyas Iyer clinches first series win as captain
content: Chasing 220, Zimbabwe's task became difficult after losing five wickets inside the first nine overs. They were eventually bowled out for 129.

title: One post, 6 words, 37 days, one resignation: How 'cockroaches' crawled into corridors of power
content: A six-word post on X sparked a massive student protest across India.  Thousands of students demanded accountability for examination irregularities and unemployment issues.  The sustained demonstrations pressured the government for over a month.  Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan eventually resigned from his post.  The movement, born online, achieved significant governmental concessions and assurances.

title: Watch: Gymnast Gabriel Langton suffers frightening head-first fall at CWG 2026
content: England gymnast Gabriel Langton suffered a severe head-first fall during the men's team final.  This terrifying incident cast a shadow over the competition and halted proceedings.  Canada secured their first men's team gymnastics gold medal in twenty years.  Rival gymnasts expressed concern and offered support for the injured athlete.  Langton was conscious and speaking with doctors before being taken to hospital.

title: Pradhan quits: What oppn can learn from CJP-led students protest
content: In a remarkable turn of events, student protests led to resignation of Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan, showcasing the power of grassroots activism. The Cockroach Janata Party, born from online memes, played a pivotal role in this uprising. Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike also fueled the movement's progress, raising critical questions for opposition parties regarding their involvement in such significant demonstrations.

title: Watch: Haaland brings 'Viking row' to Donnarumma's wedding as WC craze lives on
content: Manchester City striker Erling Haaland led guests in the Viking row celebration. This famous chant became synonymous with Norway's World Cup campaign. The event occurred during teammate Gianluigi Donnarumma's wedding festivities in Italy. Many prominent football personalities attended the lavish ceremony. Haaland's revival ensured the celebration's continued resonance with fans.

title: India script history, equal world record for most 200-plus T20I totals in a year
content: India achieved their ninth 200-plus total in T20Is for 2026. This performance matches their own world record set previously in 2024. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma led the strong batting effort against Zimbabwe. They built crucial partnerships after an early batting collapse. India's batting continues to set new standards in the shortest format.

title: Dharmendra Pradhan resigns as Union education minister amid massive student protests
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This action comes amid ongoing protests concerning the NEET paper leak. The government has taken immediate cognizance of the irregularities. Investigations were handed over to the CBI, and the exam was cancelled.

title: Karnataka boy with no internet builds space startup working with NASA
content: Awais Ahmed's startup Pixxel secured a NASA contract for Earth-observation data.  His parents nurtured his curiosity with books, which sparked his interest in space.  He pursued engineering at BITS Pilani and met his co-founder there.  Together, they founded Pixxel to build a constellation of hyperspectral satellites.  This journey highlights the impact of early curiosity and parental investment.

title: Pakistan's embarrassing blunder, field six players in five-a-side hockey game vs India
content: The incident took place on Friday shortly after the match began, when the umpires noticed Pakistan had six players on the field. Under the rules of the five-a-side format, only five players are allowed.

title: Student leader to education minister: Dharmendra Pradhan's political career before NEET row
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post on Saturday. He submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi due to ongoing protests. Pradhan's tenure saw the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020. His political journey began in student politics in Odisha many years ago. He previously held key portfolios in the Union government since 2014.

title: Who is Yash Thakur? Vidarbha pacer making his India debut against Zimbabwe
content: The 27-year-old fast bowler from Vidarbha earned his maiden India cap after consistent performances in domestic cricket and for India A.

title: Watch: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke falls to stage after being told Pradhan has resigned
content: Abhijeet Dipke fell on stage after learning of Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation.  He declared the resignation a victory but vowed protests would continue.  Dipke demanded compensation for families and action against police officers.  Pradhan accepted responsibility for the NEET paper leak controversy from the start.  Meanwhile, police dismissed rumors about a ban on food delivery services.

title: Shreyas Iyer's remarkable streak ends! India captain loses first T20I toss
content: Shreyas Iyer's remarkable eight-toss winning streak concluded in Harare on Saturday. Zimbabwe captain Sikandar Raza won the toss and chose to field first. Iyer admitted he would have preferred batting on the improved pitch conditions. Yash Thakur debuted for India, replacing Ashok Sharma in the lineup. Zimbabwe retained their unchanged playing eleven from the first match.

title: Priyanka, Alia, Vicky react to Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This development follows weeks of student protests concerning the NEET exam controversy. Many students celebrating the minister's resignation gathered at Jantar Mantar. Several Bollywood celebrities reacted positively to the news on social media platforms. Pradhan stated he took responsibility for the situation and respected youth aspirations.

title: 'We won't go': CJP's Dipke says protests to continue till all demands met
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his post.  Protests at Jantar Mantar will continue until further demands are met.  The Cockroach Janata Party founder stated two remaining demands for the government.  Compensation of one crore rupees is sought for families of suicide victims.  Action against police for alleged brutality on July twentieth is also demanded.

title: 'Congratulations, My Dear Cockroaches': Prakash Raj reacts to Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
content: Actor Prakash Raj congratulated protesters following Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. He praised their efforts for bringing a regime down to its knees. Dharmendra Pradhan announced his resignation in a public letter on X. He reflected on his commitment to students and education reforms. Celebrations followed the minister's resignation at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.

title: 'To ensure anti-national elements don't ...': Pradhan resigns - read full letter
content: Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He expressed gratitude for the opportunity to serve the nation.

title: 2-month probe, 3-month trial: Govt proposes sweeping changes to anti-cheating law
content: Under the proposed Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, investigations into offences under the Act will have to be completed within two months. The Bill empowers the Central Government to constitute a special fast track courts, wherever necessary, for investigation of offences under the Act. The amendment also proposes that trials in special fast track courts  be conducted on a day-to-day basis and completed within three months from the date of filing of the chargesheet.

title: Gambhir termed 'foolish' after ex-India selector's Sooryavanshi verdict
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi achieved a significant milestone by scoring a T20I half-century. He became the youngest player ever to reach this batting achievement. This performance followed his earlier inclusion and subsequent exclusion from the team. Former player Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticized the decision to drop him. Sooryavanshi's dedication and fearless approach were also highlighted.

title: Millions with desk jobs, millions with cervical pain
content: The rise of neck pain among young professionals in India can be attributed to the demands of desk jobs. Extended exposure to screens coupled with poor posture is leading to this unsettling health trend. Many individuals face daily discomfort that detracts from their quality of life and productivity. Medical experts report a concerning increase in younger patients. To combat this, implementing ergonomic solutions and promoting movement breaks is essential.

title: 'Arrest me if you want': Wangchuk alleges harassment; hospital clarifies
content: Activist Sonam Wangchuk released a video alleging obstruction at Safdarjung Hospital.  He was transferred to Medanta Hospital in Gurugram after court intervention.  Hospital authorities stated the video was recorded before receiving the court's written order.  Wangchuk ended his hunger strike after receiving government assurances on his demands.  His protest focused on examination reforms and protecting peaceful demonstrators.

title: Bihar bandh: Tej Pratap Yadav detained as NEET protests intensify
content: A statewide bandh occurred in Bihar over the alleged NEET paper leak. Left-wing student groups organized protests and blocked roads in several districts. Authorities increased security measures and deployed additional police personnel across the state. Protesters demanded the resignation of the Union education minister for the alleged leak. The bandh followed earlier violent clashes and stone-pelting in Patna.

title: 'Cockroach' To People's Movement: How The Student Protest Outgrew Founders

content: Bitchat is a decentralised peer-to-peer messaging application that allows users to exchange messages without an internet connection, mobile network, servers, phone numbers or email addresses.
